profile.headline: Hi I am a Computer Engineer with a passion for DevOps and efficiency. EN/ES
profile.summary: Hi, I am Computer Engineer who enjoys making teams more efficient through automation and problem solving. I have always strived to be an asset to the team and my employers. I take pride in the hard work I contribute and provide the ideal detail-oriented performance expected. I have used my communication skills in the past to provide excellent customer service, but I use them now to create a positive team environment.  I alway put in effort to meet goals and build great relationships!

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Embedded Systems lead coordinating with Scrum teams across different inter-company orgs to improve code quality and practices through DevOps

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description: Employed by RFA for work at John Deere's Intelligent Solutions Group

positions.title: Data Entry Clerk
positions.description: I did Data entry as a temp-for-hire at Praxair Distributions.

positions.title: Property Consultant
positions.description:
•Worked to maximize the opportunity of sales by providing leasing information in a professional manner and made appointments for prospects to meet with sales team

•Attended to inquires during high call volume at the contact center while maximizing efficiency with short call times and inputting the prospect’s needs

•Used a variety of computer, analytical, problem-solving, and time management skills to efficiently provide a superior experience to prospects along with excellent customer service

positions.title: Shift Leader (restaurant)
positions.description:
• Provide a safe, clean, friendly work environment

• Handle opening and closing procedures

• Cash control

• Exhibit a cheerful and helpful attitude, and provide exceptional customer service

• Train, supervise, and evaluate staff

• Receive and resolve complaints concerning food, beverages, and service

• Anticipate and react to customer volume

positions.title: Teller
positions.description:
•Was courteous while quickly assisting guests and finding financial products that match the client’s needs 

•Maintained proper cash limits, cashed checks, accepted deposits, and issued cashier’s checks, money orders, traveler’s checks, cash advances, and funds transfers

positions.title: Housekeeper
positions.description:
• To meet Ecolab standards when running laundry operations

• To maintain and carryout janitorial tasks of resort properties

• To carry out guest requests and closing laundry operations

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
• Assist in achieving and exceeding store sales and profit 

• Effectively balance personal sales and profitability goals, associate sales coaching, and the 

• Management of the business 

• Lead sales efforts in the absence of the Store Manager 

• Adhere to scheduled hours of work 

 •To provide the best customer satisfaction with knowledge, hospitality, and in accordance to prior customer needs

•To better store sales opportunity by cleanliness, organization of items, and verbal notifications of promotions.

• Take care of closing and/or opening operations (key Holder)

• Keep up to date on technological/communication trends or news

positions.title: Swing Manager
positions.description:
• By using my leadership skills and being able to think under stress I was able to
execute successful shifts by carefully placing team members in positions that 
maximized our performance as a whole crew

• I effectively handled unexpected situations with difficult customers and team 
members to provide a better environment.

• To achieve great quality by maintaining food standards and safety procedures

•  To achieve superior service through customer satisfaction, hospitality, and speedy service

•  To maintain cleanliness throughout the restaurant and strive for over average appearance

•  Handle closing operations and maintenance

• Verify kitchen expectations and employee duties

volunteerExperiences.description: Helped stock, organize, and move merchandise in retail store. Also assisted customers with loading of merchandise.
